summary: Steppin' Out AVL is a volunteer-run, free, inclusive country western line dancing and two-stepping community in Asheville, founded June 2023 by Jerri Goldberg with a team of co-founders. It now runs a rotating cast of instructors, DJs, and volunteer 'Dance Angels' greeters across weekly dances at Banks Ave. Bar and monthly dances at Hi-Wire Brewing (the unit scraped here), with a private Facebook group for regulars to share photos and videos.

evidence.note: Listings are thin: just 'Second Sunday of Each Month' with no membership language, but consistently branded as a monthly recurring series at the same brewery venue.
About page: founded by Jerri Goldberg in June 2023 as a grassroots volunteer effort (not a business), now run by a team of instructors, DJs, and volunteer 'Dance Angels' greeters.
The group maintains a private Facebook group for members to share photos/videos from dances, indicating an established returning community rather than one-off attendees.
Active Instagram presence (@steppinoutavl) alongside the dedicated steppinoutavl.org site, consistent with an ongoing community organization rather than a single instructor's class listing.

The org's own site has event pages for the Hi-Wire Brewing dates specifically, confirming this Mountain Xpress listing is one recurring node of the larger Steppin' Out AVL community, not a standalone brewery series.
